description.value: Red Label Produce, also operating as Zhao Feng Produce Ltd., is a fresh fruits and vegetables market located inside Parker Place mall on No. 3 Road in Richmond. The store sources produce from local farms as well as international suppliers and emphasizes freshness and quality selection. A touring cyclist passing through the Richmond shopping corridor would find a full range of fresh produce and grocery provisions here.
